note: David charges and instructs him at length on building the house and keeping the law.
'at the word that Gad had spoken' and came to Ornan.
Called 'Gad, David's seer'; he carries the LORD's choice of three judgments and the command to build the altar.
The threshingfloor is the place the destroying angel stood by Jerusalem; the verse locates it there without saying Ornan lived in the city.
'the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought a large quantity of cedar logs to David'; the destination is where David was, not named in the verse.
